## Current caption

> The 102-meter offset between the astronomical meridian (brass line, defined by the Airy Transit Circle) and the geodetic meridian (WGS84, used by GPS). A tourist standing on the brass strip will see their GPS showing approximately 5.3 arcseconds west of true geodetic zero.
